summary: Backend-only regression + new-feature testing for two iteration changes: (1) tts_turn now synthesizes from persisted doc['turns'][i]['text'] (previously used regex extract_turns on raw_text), and (2) proper-noun extraction — extract_dialogue_via_llm returns {dialogue, proper_nouns}, WordToken gains is_proper_noun boolean, and scenes persist a proper_nouns list. Added /app/backend/tests/test_proper_nouns_and_tts_turn.py with 9 new tests covering: (a) upload tokens carry is_proper_noun bool; (b) positive-only assertion — 'Miss', 'Whitmore', 'Boston', 'Mary', 'Jones' are all flagged for 'ELIZA: I met Miss Whitmore in Boston. Mary Jones was there too.'; (c) common words 'in', 'was', 'there', 'met', 'too' are not flagged (and 'I' is skipped by design via len>=2 rule); (d) possessive — 'Mary's' correctly flagged via the [:-1] fallback in _token_is_proper_noun; (e) GET returns the same flags as upload; (f) legacy-scene migration — used pymongo to $unset {proper_nouns, dialogue_only} on a fresh upload to simulate legacy shape; first GET runs the migration + flags proper nouns, second GET < 2s (persistence verified) and returns identical flags; (g) reparse re-detects proper nouns even on an already-migrated scene (reparse forces dialogue_only=False so the guard re-runs); (h) tts_turn on the seed Little House scene: turn 0 and turn 6 both return speakers matching doc['turns'][i]['speaker'], turn 7 → 404 — confirms endpoint reads doc['turns'] rather than regex; (i) turn-TTS cache is invalidated after reparse (cached=false on first call after reparse). Full suite (test_accent_coach.py + test_dialogue_only.py + test_turns.py + test_proper_nouns_and_tts_turn.py) = 51/51 pass in ~35s. Previous iteration's action item (tts_turn drift bug) is now fixed in server.py — verified.
critical_code_review_comments: tts_turn now correctly reads doc['turns'] after _ensure_dialogue_only, closing the previous drift bug — audio for turn i is guaranteed to match the text the UI shows for the same i.

_ensure_dialogue_only guard is 'if doc.get("dialogue_only") and "proper_nouns" in doc' — exactly matches the spec (migration re-runs only if either flag is missing). Reparse resets dialogue_only=False so the guard falls through — nice reuse.
_token_is_proper_noun handles possessives via the [:-1] fallback and skips single-letter tokens (so 'I' is never flagged) — deliberately positive-tag only.
_proper_noun_word_set flattens multi-word names like 'Miss Whitmore' into their component words and requires an initial capital — clean, avoids over-matching against articles.
server.py is now 871 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap in code-review guidelines. Consider splitting dialogue/LLM helpers, TTS endpoints, and scene-CRUD into separate modules soon.
Concurrent GETs on a legacy scene may both trigger the LLM extract + write (idempotent but wasteful) — could be gated with a per-scene lock; not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Module-scoped in-memory PDF uploads: pn-basic (Miss Whitmore/Boston/Mary Jones), pn-possessive (Mary's book), pn-legacy (mutated in mongo to unset proper_nouns + dialogue_only to simulate a legacy scene), pn-cache. All are deleted in fixture teardown. Read-only usage of seed scene 4b23e55d-67be-42bc-a397-4eb4085bdb2e.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && set -a && source .env && set +a && export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && python -m pytest tests/ -v. The new proper-noun tests are POSITIVE-ONLY per problem statement (no upper-bound count assertion) since Claude may occasionally over-tag. The tts_turn-drift bug from iteration 3 is verified fixed. If server.py exceeds ~1000 lines, recommend splitting.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions or bugs found this iteration. Previously flagged tts_turn drift is now resolved (endpoint uses doc['turns'] after _ensure_dialogue_only).
